fib.workload: Recursive fib(40), one process invocation; same recurrence in Turbo/Rust.

wordcount.workload: Existing 5MiB seeded ASCII corpus, word frequencies, top20 count-desc/lexical ties.
wordcount.oracle: Independent Python Counter and ordered top20 plus total/unique.
wordcount.comparison_caveat: Idiomatic end-to-end comparison, NOT identical implementation: Turbo selects top20 by repeated scan; Rust sorts all counts; token/storage paths also differ.

json_transform.workload: Seeded records with strings/control/Unicode, numbers and bools; parse/filter/project/serialize.
json_transform.oracle: Parsed records equal an independent semantic oracle; bytes counted; freeze dataset before implementation.

string_tokens.workload: 1048576 cyclic visits over eight frozen UTF-8 log records. Split literal pipe, trim ASCII space/tab/CR/LF margins, replace INFO:/WARN: labels and em dash literally, skip empty fields, count tokens, emit lexical token/count sequence and total tokens/unique/processed input bytes (excluding record newlines).
string_tokens.oracle: Independent weighted per-record Counter (no native iteration loop); exact UTF-8 stdout and SHA256 verified every sample.
string_tokens.comparison_caveat: Same safe token/count algorithm; string allocation and hashing implementations differ. Includes a small corpus file read and final ordering. Unicode text is preserved except explicit em-dash replacement: no Unicode case-fold/NFC/general whitespace parity claim.

hashmap_churn.workload: 2097152 steps; LCG31 seed7/multiplier1103515245/increment12345;4096 integer and precomputed string keys; increment current key, remove(key+17)%4096 every seventh step; weighted final digests and lengths.
hashmap_churn.oracle: Reference dictionary results plus final digest; fixed live working set.
hashmap_churn.comparison_caveat: Same abstract operation trace; hashing/container implementations and key ownership differ. Rust borrows precomputed immutable string keys; Turbo runtime manages key storage. Measures language plus runtime, not backend in isolation.

buffer_scan.workload: 33554432 logical u8 values; initial (17*i+23)%256, four in-place passes adding pass+1 modulo256; dependent checksum (33*h+value)%1000000007.
buffer_scan.oracle: Periodic affine composition, independently cross-checked against literal bytearray simulation; checksum, first and last byte.

particle_update.workload: 10000 particles,32768 symplectic Euler steps,dt=1/64; six f64 fields initialized by Park-Miller LCG seed7,multiplier48271,mod2147483647, (state%2048-1024)/1024. Update velocity before position; digest all six final fields on the exact 1/65536 lattice.
particle_update.oracle: Independent closed-form integer trajectory; cross-tested with literal fixed-step lattice simulation. Exact digest,size,steps; no float tolerance.
particle_update.comparison_caveat: Same safe AoS update algorithm; current Turbo managed records and Rust inline Vec records have different physical storage/ownership costs. Baseline is not packed/noalloc Turbo or a renderer/frame-latency test. Sub-200ms samples remain unqualified.

tree_walk.workload: Seeded acyclic allocation-heavy tree, deterministic traversal/drop.
tree_walk.oracle: Reference traversal result and balanced allocation accounting.

sqlite.workload: Seeded database, transactional batch insert and ordered query workload.
sqlite.oracle: Exact rows/transaction outcomes with matching SQLite configuration.

http_compute.workload: Fixed compute request bodies at declared rate/concurrency.
http_compute.oracle: Response oracle and error counts; measure latency separately.

worker.workload: Fixed job set and documented retries/recovery schedule.
worker.oracle: Durable state/effect oracle; no acknowledged loss.
worker.prerequisite: G5 worker kit and fault harness
